> As open world video games set in Indonesia, CDID offer a wide variety of cars for players to choose from. These cars range from classic and vintage models to modern vehicles, reflecting the diversity of the automotive industry in Indonesia. Players can find popular Indonesian brands such as Toyota, Honda, Mitsubishi, and more, as well as international car manufacturers. The game developers strive to create a realistic driving experience, paying attention to factors such as vehicle physics, handling, and sound design. Players can expect different driving dynamics based on the type of car they choose, whether it's a sports car, a sedan, a family car, or an off-road vehicle but relatively smaller than a truck/lorry, bus, and train, but larger than a motorcycle and bicycle. The following is a list of cars in CDID.

### CRAFTING THE METAVERSE

We turn ambitious ideas into high-quality, immersive Roblox experiences. CDID Studio provides the technical expertise to bring your unique vision to life.

Think of us as your extended development team. We collaborate closely with you to build standout Roblox experiences that keep players coming back.

[See What We Build](https://www.roblox.com/games/6911148748)

## Explore Our World

A visual collection of our immersive Indonesia map scale - crafted with intention, detail, and realistic style.

![Map Jakarta](https://i.ibb.co.com/7NJLpFPs/Roblox-Screen-Shot20260215-091612747.png)

#### Map Jakarta

Perfect for urban roleplay. Drive through Jakarta’s most prestigious business districts.

![Map Jawa Barat](https://i.ibb.co.com/DgGBkjVx/Roblox-Screen-Shot20260215-092242331.png)

#### Map Jawa Barat

A breath of fresh air. Experience the beauty of West Java’s rural landscapes and high-speed toll runs.

![Map BSD](https://i.ibb.co.com/7tCbHMNt/Roblox-Screen-Shot20260215-092336782.png)

#### Map BSD City

Modern living meets high-end driving. Explore the sophisticated streets of one of Indonesia’s most planned cities.

![Map Jawa Tengah](https://i.ibb.co.com/DfkTbYmy/Roblox-Screen-Shot20260215-190100827.png)

#### Map Jawa Tengah

The heart of Java. Drive through historic cities and long stretches of the Trans-Java toll road with beautiful paddy field views.

![Sirkuit Sentul](https://i.ibb.co.com/vvmm9RPw/Roblox-Screen-Shot20260222-160229206.png)

#### Sirkuit Internasional

Escape the city heat. Test your car’s performance on steep climbs and sharp corners in the scenic Sentul highlands.

![Map Jawa Timur](https://i.ibb.co.com/vC5XzFTy/Roblox-Screen-Shot20260215-092454366.png)

#### Map Jawa Timur

From the industrial bustle of Surabaya to the misty slopes of Kediri. A diverse terrain for every type of driver.

![Map Bali](https://i.ibb.co.com/wr3wXyrM/Roblox-Screen-Shot20260215-093722875.png)

#### Map Bali

Vacation mode: ON. Cruise along the sun-drenched coasts, tropical greenery, and the famous Bali Mandara Toll Road.

![Map Bandalam](https://i.ibb.co.com/TVKbVZR/Roblox-Screen-Shot20260215-193427832.png)

#### Map Bandalam

The gateway to the city. Navigate the complex highway interchanges and bustling airport perimeters.

![Map PIK 2](https://i.ibb.co.com/JRvm3KZx/Roblox-Screen-Shot20260222-161206947.png)

#### Map PIK 2

Luxury at every turn. Drive through the most hyped modern township with wide roads and stunning waterfront views.

## FAQ's

Looking for answers to your frequently asked questions? Check out our FAQ below.

How do I join the CDID Roblox server?

Joining the action is simple! Search for "Car Driving Indonesia" on the Roblox platform or click the "Play CDID" button at the top of this page to be redirected instantly. Make sure you have the Roblox player installed and a registered account to start your journey.

Is CDID free to play?

Yes, CDID is completely Free to Play! You can explore our expansive maps and enjoy core gameplay features at no cost. For players looking to enhance their experience, we offer exclusive gamepasses and in-game currency for premium vehicle upgrades and customizations.

How can I report bugs or suggest features?

We value your feedback! To report technical issues or share your ideas for new features, please join our Official CDID Discord Server and use the dedicated #reports or #suggestions channels. Our development team and moderators actively review these submissions to improve the game.

What devices are supported?

CDID is optimized for a wide range of devices, including PC, Mac, and Mobile (iOS/Android). To ensure a smooth experience while exploring high-detail areas like Jakarta or East Java, we recommend a device with at least 4GB of RAM and a stable internet connection.

Can I use CDID assets for my own projects?

All maps, vehicle systems, and custom scripts are the intellectual property of CDID Studio. Unauthorized use, redistribution, or modification of our assets for external projects is strictly prohibited.

Still need help?

Join our community on [Discord](https://discord.gg/CDID) or reach out to our support team directly.
